items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I think we had Ed Rome. Yeah, Ed Rome.

ctx.x: No, we didn't have Joe Keyes. I think we had Ed Rome. Yeah, Ed Rome. He had a brother who played trumpet with another band -- I forget what band that was. Anyway, I think that's who I think was on trumpet, Ed Rome. Because Coatner(?), he couldn't go. He had to stay there. He was playing trumpet.
And was it only Army camps that you play?
